lcc_original: 你種地，地必不再給你效力：你必流離飄蕩於地上。
notes: LCC adds 必 in the first clause (地必不再) as a modal intensifier with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
LCC uses 於 instead of UNV's 在 for the prepositional phrase; same SNs H9002+H776 applied to 於地上
{<WH03588>} (כִּי) and {<WAH0853>} (אֵת) remain implicit braces — LCC likewise has no explicit words for either
Second-clause 必 in LCC (你必流離) corresponds to תִּהְיֶה (H1961) exactly as in UNV, retaining <WAH01961><WTH8799>
